quote: I've been interested for a while. I just haven't haven't had time to
stewart_read: A customer who says she's been wanting solar for a while but hasn't gotten around to it is a strong forward lean — the rep should reflect this back as urgency ('let's get this handled for you today') but instead treated it as a checkbox.
coaching_implication: Reflect stated long-standing interest into a same-call booking push rather than letting it pass unused.

quote: there's no out of pocket or upfront cost needed, for our program.
stewart_read: Rep launches into full program mechanics (cost model, savings framing) in response to a pricing question instead of using the escape hatch to redirect to the specialist.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read: rep felt pressured to answer directly rather than deflect, since customer asked pointedly.
coaching_implication: Use the specialist redirect for pricing/mechanism questions: 'that's exactly what our specialist walks through in detail.'

quote: So so what is the out of pocket cost upfront?
stewart_read: Second time she raises upfront cost; rep again gives a flat 'There is none' answer instead of creating curiosity toward a specialist call or a personalized proposal.
coaching_implication: Repeated cost question is an opening to redirect to design/proposal rather than repeat the same canned line.

quote: Why why do I have to have a, a credit score of 650 if there's nothing out of pocket?
stewart_read: Direct logic challenge to the qualifier; rep's response ('that's for documentation and for qualification') doesn't resolve the contradiction and opens the credibility gap further.
alternative_hypothesis: Reactive read: rep doesn't have a clean answer prepared for this specific inconsistency and is improvising.
coaching_implication: Prepare a clean one-line reconciliation of 'no cost' vs. credit qualifier before fielding it live; don't let the contradiction sit unresolved.

quote: I don't have the the details on my end.
stewart_read: Honest admission of a knowledge gap on the leasing program, immediately followed by redirect to specialist — this is the correct recovery pattern.
coaching_implication: This is the right move; contrast it with the earlier over-explaining at 01:19 where he should have deferred instead.

quote: You gave me the information I needed. That's that's helpful. So, thank you for calling.
stewart_read: Call ends with no appointment offered or attempted at all — the customer self-terminates the call and the rep just says goodbye.
coaching_implication: Rep should have proposed booking the specialist call before she could close the conversation herself.
